methodology.core: Reuse composed_monthly_target from the frozen growth-satellite helper:half of equity in actual unleveragedQQQ,and half equally divided across4existing factor families. Monthly inverse63-session aggregate-equity/gold volatility balance with30%-70%equity bounds. No daily12%volatility cap in this new control.
methodology.protection: Ratchet a floor to85%of the highest actual closing model-account NAV,including initialUSD10,000anchor. At a known close scale the monthly non-BIL target by the positive wealth cushion divided by15%of currentNAV,capped at1. The implied cushion multiplier is1/0.15,derived from the retained drawdown target rather than fitted.
methodology.cash: The control keeps98%target investment. The protected portfolio moves every removed risky weight to actualBIL,with no borrowing,synthetic interest or upward leverage. All4economic equity families remain proportional within the current risky core.
methodology.trigger: Initial and monthly updates request trades. Between month ends,only the protected rule trades when some desired target differs from actual closing holding weight by at least5percentage points. High-water mark and cushion update only from already realized closing NAV.
methodology.pending: One pending request at a time;fills at its original delayed open,never overwritten. A monthly update that occurs while another request is pending remains requested until the next eligible close. Protection depends on cost/delay/fresh-window account state and must regenerate separately for every path.
methodology.execution: PreserveUSD10,000fresh10y/5yaccounts,USD1tickets,5bpnext-openbaseand20bpextra-sessionstress. Versioned funded-accounting replay and independentbt required;original netSharpe/SPY/15%drawdown gates unchanged.
methodology.limitations: This is an unleveraged ratcheted-floor adaptation motivated byCPPI,not the paper's exact implementation or guaranteed capital protection. Gaps,execution delay,trade band,costs and cash lock-in can breach the target or reduce return.
methodology.factors: QQQis concentrated growth/market beta,not an independent fifth factor or a new definition. This experiment uses only already registered families;it does not register queued IJR/PKWearly,change their Oct17eligibility or compute six-family outcomes.
methodology.selection: Two fixed hypotheses after108exposed historical configurations,no multiplier/window/asset-share grid. Historical qualification would still not establish independent forward results;the prior22candidate selection diagnostic does not cover these new candidates.
methodology.source: Original actual growth/factor/defense snapshots and helper versions remain frozen. Current17source prospective archive does not includeQQQ,so no prospective performance for this new study is claimed.
